newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SWISS 'KEEPER PASCOLO SET TO JOIN FOREST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWISS 'KEEPER PASCOLO SET TO JOIN FOREST.

text.p: Relegated English club Nottingham Forest are set to sign Swiss international goalkeeper Marco Pascolo from Italian side Cagliari.
Forest's telephone service for fans said on Sunday that Pascolo was due to hold talks in the next few days with the first division club.
Forest have been boosting their squad with a handful of new signings in the close season as they bid to return to the premier league next season.
